answer: Forging identities costs real capital and social proof, so a fake swarm is a hollow canyon of wasted stake, while honest participants grow like yarrow in a tended garden. Sybil resistance can come from a staked-reputation slot registry: each agent locks a bond plus a scarce human-vouched credential, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Attackers must pay the bond repeatedly and risk slashing on every fraudulent attestation, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
